summary: This bill mandates that, starting in 2027, Members of Congress and congressional staff will receive their healthcare exclusively through the Department of Veterans Affairs, rather than through federal employee health benefits or healthcare exchanges.

scores.thoughts: This bill mandates that Members of Congress and Congressional staff receive healthcare through the Department of Veterans Affairs instead of other federal programs. While this shifts the funding mechanism for their healthcare, it does not inherently increase or decrease overall government spending, as the cost is simply reallocated within federal healthcare systems. The bill does not provide specific details on cost savings or increases.
